Rae: Heads-up RCA published for the quantization mismatch incident: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2244444444-quantization-regression
Rae: TL;DR: an overly aggressive int8 quantization profile changed rounding behavior for a narrow set of long-context prompts, causing a measurable quality regression (~0.8% increase in factuality errors) during a 32m window. Most traffic degraded in the 99th pct.
Rae: Full doc includes timeline, diffs, repro harness, anonymized samples, and a suggested customer note.
Rae: Action items (owners + targets) called out in the doc:
- Owen 1: pin quantization profile to previous safe build and publish a backout package 1 target 2026-04-04
- Mina 1: add a float-vs-quantized nightly eval on the long-context eval set and gate releases on hallucination delta <0.2% 1 target 2026-04-02
- Carlos 1: add release-checklist item + CI smoke check for quantized output diffs and a pre-deploy warning 1 target 2026-03-31
Rae: I've also added a short rollback playbook and a canary plan (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1, 1% -> 10% -> 100%) in the doc. Please leave ownership comments there.
Owen: Starting the pin/revert now. Will open PR and tag @eng-ml and @eng-runtime. Expect PR + backout package by EOD.
Mina: I'll wire up the eval and post initial graphs to the doc tomorrow morning. Suggest we track both "hallucination-rate-long" and "token-level divergence".
Carlos: I'll add the CI gate and a preflight script that diffs outputs for a small curated prompt set. Will include a failure immunization policy for noisy examples.
